verdict.rationale: Publishing an uptime SLA and a public status page is a fair question for a SaaS product like Basecamp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, uptime guarantees, a status page or incident reporting. The items cover features, pricing and API details only.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
